records.title: LoRA-C: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Robust CNN for IoT Devices
records.reason: LoRA-C applies parameter-efficient fine-tuning to robust CNN classifiers for IoT vision tasks. Parameter efficiency is a training property here; the paper does not optimize LLM inference, and its CNN architecture/task is distinct from the cited LoRA-pruning language-model system.

records.title: Customize Your Visual Autoregressive Recipe with Set Autoregressive Modeling
records.reason: Set Autoregressive Modeling changes the token grouping/order for visual autoregressive image generation. The evaluated generation domain is images rather than text LLM inference, and the paper does not demonstrate a language-serving efficiency result; the multi-token-prediction citation is a conceptual autoregressive analogy, not a shared LLM method.

records.title: Dynamic Fog Computing for Enhanced LLM Execution in Medical Applications
records.reason: Full paper describes SpeziLLM deployment across edge/fog/cloud, but its evaluation emphasizes framework usability and healthcare case studies rather than measured latency, memory, or inference-cost results.

records.title: From Efficient Multimodal Models to World Models: A Survey
records.reason: Full text reviews transformer pruning, quantization, attention/KV efficiency and multimodal/world-model methods; it is a broad survey, not a new validated serving intervention, but is related to the cited sparse-attention lineage.
